meta.name: System Design Lab
meta.description: Visual distributed systems simulator for deep technical learning
meta.northStar: The Oscilloscope — measurement instrument, data IS the UI

bg-void.name: Absolute Black
bg-void.note: App background. Deepest surface. Nothing below this.

surface-instrument.name: Instrument Panel
surface-instrument.note: All panel/card surfaces. Primary reading surface.

surface-raised.name: Lifted Carbon
surface-raised.note: Hover states, elevated cells, raised elements.

border-hairline.name: Graphite Hairline
border-hairline.note: ALL borders. Every panel edge and separator.

ink-dim.name: Pale Slate
ink-dim.note: Secondary text, ghost button labels, inactive states.

ink-primary.name: Signal White
ink-primary.note: All metric values, node labels, active content.

signal-healthy.name: Throughput Green
signal-healthy.note: SEMANTIC: healthy throughput, success, primary action border.

signal-warning.name: Warning Gold
signal-warning.note: SEMANTIC: elevated load, warning threshold, half-open circuit breaker.

signal-error.name: Error Crimson
signal-error.note: SEMANTIC: errors, failures, saturated nodes, destructive actions.

signal-info.name: Telemetry Cyan
signal-info.note: SEMANTIC: p95/p99 latency, cost values, selection highlights.

canvas-light.name: Paper White
canvas-light.note: Light mode bg only. Not used in primary dark experience.

typographyMeta.rationale: Sans for UI chrome (labels, buttons, panel headers). Mono for live data (every measurement, rate, latency). The split is semantic: mono = measurement, sans = label.

elevationNote: Dark mode: NO box-shadow on any panel or card. Depth via tonal layers (bg-void → surface-instrument → surface-raised). Hairline borders define edges. Light mode only: card-shadow (0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,0.04), 0 2px 8px rgba(15,23,42,0.06)).
